problem_type: Creator language incorrectly determines generation encoder input
symptom: Korean lantern intent produces unrelated crowd images; Korean node translation reports no text.
direct_cause: Agent schemas force user-language generation prompts while translator counts only Han/Latin.
class_root: Generation encoder language and creator response language are conflated.
affected_population: Korean and other non-Latin generation prompts
Desktop and native MCP draft_shots callers

external_sources.purpose: The affected SD1.5 model card identifies English language and weaker non-English prompt performance; use source-vs-English real GPU comparison.

invariants: Creator titles, dialogue and source document remain verbatim.
Actual generation prompt is visible before approval; default encoder-facing language is English unless the selected model declares otherwise.
Hangul/Kana/Han text is translatable while asset URLs do not count as language.

door_reduction.why_not: Tool declaration, node translation, lane assembly and context assembly are distinct necessary consumers; instruction truth is centralized rather than deleting supported surfaces.

generality_proof: All canonical tools consume one language instruction; desktop response language no longer overrides it. Unicode script classes cover Hangul including decomposed Jamo, Kana and Han without model/vendor branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Separate model-facing prompt language from creator-facing titles and originals.
Determine target language from text scripts excluding reference tokens.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: draft_shots publishes shared CANVAS_NODE_PROMPT_GUIDELINES to native web and desktop engines.
All response locales consume the same generation-specific instruction.
Existing selection-aware translator uses shared script detector.

recurrence.reason: Every new Korean shot on English-oriented encoders repeats this instruction conflict.
same_class_scan: rg SAME language / every prompt you write / detectTranslateDirection in src electron web

prevention.invariant: Generation instructions are independent of UI response locale.
prevention.failure_mode: No hidden provider-time rewrite; original spend review shows exact submitted prompt.
prevention.strategy: Replace contradictory schema/system instructions with one shared generation-language rule and broaden the existing script detector.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove forced user-language/Chinese generation instructions; preserve response-language policy.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No runtime dependency owns this internal instruction conflict; use native agent translation and existing user-visible prompt review.

migration: No stored prompt is rewritten. Existing drafts remain explicit; new drafts use corrected guidance and translator only acts on user request.
residual_risks: Prompt guidance is probabilistic; actual GPU semantic comparison required.
English does not guarantee every model follows every scene correctly.
